items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Dave Peyton; Interviewee responds with general knowledge about Peyton's penmanship and arrangements ('He wrote... He had fantastic penmanship for his arrangements.'), but does not describe a personal interaction or close relationship.

ctx.x: Because they had a lot of...a cluster of theatres around there.

Yeah. Well, they had the Grand Theatre across the street. The Grand was over on the west side, and Dave Peyton played over there -- he had the band. Erskine Tate had the band at the Vendome, which was on the east side of the street.
